1.text: Zaburi ya Dawidi.Uwiteka ni we mwungeri wanjye sinzakena,

2.text: Andyamisha mu cyanya cy'ubwatsi bubisi,Anjyana iruhande rw'amazi adasuma.

3.text: Asubiza intege mu bugingo bwanjye,Anyobora inzira yo gukiranuka ku bw'izina rye.

4.text: Naho nanyura mu gikombe cy'igicucu cy'urupfu,Sinzatinya ikibi cyose kuko ndi kumwe nawe,Inshyimbo yawe n'inkoni yawe ni byo bimpumuriza.

5.text: Untunganiriza ameza mu maso y'abanzi banjye,Unsīze amavuta mu mutwe,Igikombe cyanjye kirasesekara.

6.text: Ni ukuri kugirirwa neza n'imbabazi,bizanyomaho iminsi yose nkiriho,Nanjye nzaba mu nzu y'Uwiteka iteka ryose.
